summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange announcement dated 12 October 2026 regarding a grant of conditional share awards under its International Employee Share Purchase Plan. On 9 October 2026, HSBC granted awards over 274,529.87745 ordinary shares (142,259.68627 LSE-listed; 132,270.19118 HKSE-listed) at a zero purchase price, with a two-year vesting period and no performance conditions or clawback given the all-employee nature. Closing prices were GBP 13.958 and HKD 145.20. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
